app_info.subtitle: Read-only Echo operations
app_info.description: Search and fetch the Echo SDK registry, inspect privacy-reduced Persona Forge identities, and retrieve bounded official public-safety context.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the capability registry and cannot change state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns internal registry metadata without external side effects.
justifications.destructive_justification: Has no delete, overwrite, revoke, publish, or mutation path.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one exact capability record and cannot change state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns internal registry metadata without external side effects.
justifications.destructive_justification: Has no delete, overwrite, revoke, publish, or mutation path.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads privacy-reduced persona metadata and cannot change a persona.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads an internal registry and causes no external side effect.
justifications.destructive_justification: Persona creation, update, activation, and deletion are absent.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one privacy-reduced persona and cannot change it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads an internal registry and causes no external side effect.
justifications.destructive_justification: Persona creation, update, activation, and deletion are absent.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads bounded official public data and freshness metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: It performs read-only requests to fixed official NWS, USGS, and NASA EONET sources but never dispatches, posts, messages, or mutates them.
justifications.destructive_justification: It has no mutation or irreversible operation.

test_cases.expected_output: One bounded sanitized record for echo.a2a.health and no unrelated capability.

test_cases.user_prompt: Fetch the capability record for echo.a2a.health.
test_cases.expected_output: The exact safe capability record without internal targets or credentials.
At most two privacy-reduced active persona records.
The privacy-reduced c3po identity without prompt, path, notes, or provider IDs.

test_cases.user_prompt: Get official public-safety context for Texas, limit two.
test_cases.expected_output: At most two bounded context entries with source freshness metadata.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search my computer for password files.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app does not activate because file and secret search are unsupported.
The app does not approximate a destructive action with a read tool.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a poem about a thunderstorm.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app does not activate for creative writing without live operational data.
